# Feature 1: Price relative to a normalized product_id range
# Products with higher IDs might be newer/more expensive - capture relative price positioning
df['price_per_product_magnitude'] = df['price'] / (np.log1p(df['product_id']) + 1)

# Feature 2: User behavior indicator - ratio of user_id to price
# Higher user IDs (possibly newer users) may interact differently with prices
df['user_price_ratio'] = df['user_id'] / (df['price'] + 1)

# Feature 3: Price bucketized relative to mean - deviation from average price
# Events (view/cart/purchase) often depend on whether item is cheap or expensive
price_mean = df['price'].mean()
price_std = df['price'].std()
df['price_zscore_abs'] = np.abs((df['price'] - price_mean) / (price_std + 1e-9))

# Feature 4: Log of price - purchase events more likely at certain price points (non-linear)
df['log_price'] = np.log1p(df['price'])

# Feature 5: Interaction between log_price and log_product_id
# Captures combined effect of product identity and price on event type
df['price_product_log_interact'] = df['log_price'] * np.log1p(df['product_id'])
